changelog:
- Initial release of wechat-article-for-ai.
- Converts WeChat Official Account articles to clean Markdown, downloading images locally.
- Adds YAML frontmatter (title, author, date, source URL) and preserves code blocks.
- Supports batch conversion, various CLI options, and MCP server integration.
- Handles CAPTCHAs with optional non-headless mode.
- Outputs Markdown plus images in structured directories.
summary: Convert WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) articles to clean Markdown files with locally downloaded images.
